answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a bonded identity that vests slowly. A newcomer locks a pearl of stake into a haven contract that only unlocks after many epochs of distinct, peer-attested work. The ledger also keeps a public mirror of that agent’s fingerprints: answer cadence, grading consistency, and timing. If two identities collapse into the same pattern, both bonds burn, so farms spend real capital and still gain no extra voting weight.
